units.title: Reliable retrieval and evaluation
required_capability_prerequisites: P1: actual generation/embeddings/vector retrieval and learner ownership
deliverables: Versioned ingestion, upsert, deletion and provenance behavior; data-quality tests.
Keyword/vector comparison; hybrid/reranking only if a measured failure justifies it.
Labeled evaluation set targeting at least 100 total cases with documented source, development/held-out split, answerability and adversarial categories.
Applied Python/SQL/statistics/ML exercises linked to retrieval metrics, leakage, baselines and error analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Run an unchanged baseline and one proposed change on the same development cases; report exact counts and regression/failure taxonomy.
Show that deletion/version updates remove obsolete evidence from retrieval.
Held-out release evaluation is separate from tuning; dataset size alone is not a quality pass.

Before held-out release scoring, predeclare and justify a measurable useful-workflow criterion (grounded-answer correctness, abstention, unacceptable errors and latency as relevant) against the non-AI baseline. Freeze config/data, score the held-out set and require the criterion to pass; a large dataset or an improvement alone is not a release pass.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: No mandatory paid service; local real model/vector capacity still required.
required_evidence: Dataset manifest/rubric, retrieval/data tests, per-case eval results, failure analysis and learner explanation.
units.budget_rule: Default 60 DSA + 30 roleprep + 90 AI = 180 minutes; DSA75/90 leaves AI75/60. Interview-near mode reallocates explicitly. Carry work, never squeeze same scope or add hours.
units.weekly_visibility_rule: 30 minutes every 7 actual learning days, inside AI budget; accounted globally, not charged twice here.

units.title: Security, identity and deployment preparation
required_capability_prerequisites: M2.1: working data and evaluation baseline
deliverables: Actual authentication and server-side document/tenant access enforcement using an appropriate established mechanism.
Threat model, secrets/config separation, retention/deletion, input/output boundaries and audit trail.
Containerized service and reproducible CI/CD preparation, trace propagation, bounded retries/deadlines and performance/cost budget.

Incremental practical cloud/course gaps only: use the existing C0 first 30-day syllabus/diagnostic result to choose project-linked AWS labs; do not charge the initial diagnostic again or invent an exam-readiness date.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-user/tenant access tests fail closed at the server and retrieval boundary, not only in the UI/prompt.
Clean build/tests and configuration work without embedding secrets; prove logs do not expose protected content by default.
Explain selected AWS identity/network/storage/compute choices and remaining real-deployment steps.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: Local identity/security tests can proceed without paid cloud; no live-cloud credit yet.
required_evidence: Threat model, auth/isolation/security test receipts, reproducible build, tracing sample and cloud diagnostic gap map.

units.title: Real AWS and hosted-model delivery
required_capability_prerequisites: M2.2: safe application and deployment preparation
deliverables: User-authorized AWS account/region/services with spend ceiling, alerts/limits and teardown plan.
Actual cloud application deployment with real identity, network, storage, configuration and logging controls; IaC or reproducible equivalent.
At least one authorized real AWS-hosted model integration (AWS Bedrock or an approved real AWS model sandbox) with actual request/result, model/config, exposed usage and honest cost methodology.
Redeploy, rollback/restore, teardown/recreate evidence and one failure/incident drill.
acceptance_criteria: Read back the actual resources/configuration and live request/trace; local containers, emulators or Terraform plan alone do not pass.
Observe a real successful hosted-model request and bounded error/deadline behavior; use safely injected tests for rare failures rather than deliberately exhausting quotas.
Show observed usage/billing where available; mark unavailable fields instead of fabricating values.
Cloud and hosted-provider capability gates remain blocked separately if their permissions/budgets are unavailable.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: Cloud and hosted inference require explicit account/service/cost authorization.
A real vendor sandbox can supply only the controls it actually exposes; record provisioned-lab limitations.
Independent tools/eval/DSA learning continues while external access is blocked.

AWS budget alerts are not a guaranteed hard spending cap. Bound workloads/tokens/requests, apply available quotas, short resource lifetimes and teardown, and obtain approval acknowledging residual billing risk before provisioning.
required_evidence: Authorized-resource inventory, deployment/rollback/teardown receipts, live trace, hosted-provider receipt, usage/cost evidence and incident note.

units.title: Bounded developer workflow
required_capability_prerequisites: M2.2: local security and input boundaries
not_required_for_independent_start: M2.3: live cloud and hosted provider are not required merely to start local tools work
deliverables: Small developer assistant that reads an allowed scratch repository and test log, forms a bounded plan and proposes a reviewable patch.
Compare deterministic workflow versus agentic planner; use the simpler design when it performs adequately.
Actual allowlisted tool execution with typed arguments, scope/resource limits, cancellation and trace IDs.
acceptance_criteria: A real tool reads actual allowed repository content; no canned-output-only proof.
Attempts to read outside scope or execute an unapproved action are denied by code.
Explain one agent failure from an actual trace and the chosen deterministic alternative/fallback.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: No external repository write or arbitrary terminal authority is implied.
Local model capability may be insufficient for planning quality; record that blocker honestly.
required_evidence: Workflow implementation, task set, actual tool trace, baseline comparison, scope/cancellation tests and limitations.

units.title: Genuine MCP and exact-action approval
deliverables: An actual MCP server and client connection using the current official protocol/SDK documentation.
Tool schemas, allowed resources, error handling and one meaningful controlled local mutation such as writing a patch proposal into an owned scratch workspace.
Explicit user approval bound to exact action/arguments/target, invalidated on changes; audit and replay protection appropriate to the scope.
acceptance_criteria: Record a real protocol client/server tool exchange, not merely JSON shaped like a tool call.
Changed, expired, replayed or missing approval cannot authorize a write.
Model output and retrieved tool results remain untrusted; no prompt can expand filesystem/network authority.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: Local stdio/server integration is valid protocol evidence, not a claim of remote enterprise OAuth.
Any real external write still requires explicit separate authorization.
required_evidence: Protocol/version receipt, server/client tests, approval-denial tests, real controlled-write receipt and audit trace.

units.title: Agent evaluation and operational safety
deliverables: Task-success evaluation with development/held-out tasks, tool/planning/retrieval/authorization failure classes and repeated-action cases.
Injection/exfiltration tests with synthetic data, limits/timeouts, idempotency where applicable and human escalation.
Runbook and authorized deployment/operation of the scoped assistant when cloud permission exists; otherwise preserve the deployment blocker.
acceptance_criteria: Show actual task outcome traces and a targeted regression improvement, not just an agent demo.
No unapproved write, scope escape or secret access in deterministic boundary tests.
A human can inspect the proposed action, deny it and recover from a partial failure.

Predeclare a scoped task-success criterion and zero-tolerance deterministic authorization failures before release evaluation; freeze the version and score a held-out task set. A largely nonfunctional agent does not pass merely because traces exist or one metric improved.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: Local evaluation proceeds independently; real deployment remains blocked/unpassed without authorized live access.
required_evidence: Task dataset, eval report/traces, safety tests, incident/recovery exercise and deployment status with exact limits.

units.title: Customer discovery and pilot contract
required_capability_prerequisites: P1: problem brief and honest scope
At least one functioning application with known limitations
not_required_for_independent_start: Cloud completion is not required to conduct discovery; use only an honest available demo
deliverables: Discovery conversation or clearly labeled role-play covering workflow, stakeholders, data/access, non-AI baseline, risks and success measures.
Small pilot scope, non-goals, responsibility map, acceptance/rollback criteria and a customer-facing explanation.
Seek an authorized real reviewer/user opportunity; no automatic outreach or data sharing.
acceptance_criteria: Questions precede solution design and can lead to a non-AI or no-go decision.
Real-user, peer and role-play evidence are labeled distinctly.
No adoption, business savings, customer identity or production history is fabricated.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: Real external contact/data access needs the applicable user authorization.
If no real user is available, simulated discovery can pass the exercise but not a real-customer-experience gate.
required_evidence: Problem/pilot brief, discovery notes, data-access constraints, proposed baseline and truthful evidence classification.

units.title: Change, operate and recover
required_capability_prerequisites: Working local app and security fundamentals
not_required_for_independent_start: Live cloud operations require M2.3; local drills can proceed separately
deliverables: Feedback-driven change request with data/API compatibility and rollback concerns.
Quality/availability/latency/cost observation, trace-based incident diagnosis and recovery.
Retention/deletion verification, runbook updates and cloud/certification gap study tied to real operational decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A changed requirement produces a minimal tested patch and explicit risk/rollback record.
An incident drill has evidence of detection, diagnosis, mitigation, recovery and prevention; label drill versus real incident.
Do not claim sustained production reliability from a short benchmark or local drill.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: Actual cloud/pilot evidence requires the relevant access gates; missing scope is retained.
required_evidence: Change diff/tests, incident timeline, operational observations, runbook and updated risk/evidence map.

units.title: Independent integration and handoff
deliverables: Two unfamiliar-repository debugging/integration exercises using original lawful tasks.
Clean-clone handoff/reproduction by a peer where available; otherwise accurately labeled self-run verification.
Five-minute technical demo with failure path, architecture Q&A and nontechnical value explanation.
acceptance_criteria: Independently reproduce a defect, identify root cause, patch minimally, add regression coverage and explain blast radius.
Separate personal implementation from borrowed/tutorial/assistant work.
Document real reviewer feedback and one response to it if a reviewer is available; no invented independent review.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: A human review is preferred, not assumed or forged; obtain appropriate sharing authorization.
required_evidence: Two attempt receipts/rubrics, patch/tests, clean-run result, handoff feedback/status and demo/decision log.

units.title: Unseen interview gates and targeted repair
required_capability_prerequisites: Baseline attempts and available project evidence
not_required_for_independent_start: Applications/practice need not wait for every project or cloud permission
deliverables: Six gates: independent coding/DSA; unfamiliar repository; system design; AI evaluation/delivery; discovery/ambiguity; behavioral/project explanation.
Use two unseen original exercises on separate days for each critical gate, honoring tool/AI allowances.

DSA coding mocks replace DSA blocks. The 20 hours of non-DSA formal assessment accrue across recurring role-bank windows throughout the core, excluding AWS sessions; they are not 20 hours squeezed into P5 or additionally charged to AI.
acceptance_criteria: Proposed rehearsal threshold: at least 3/4 in critical dimensions on both attempts, no critical correctness/safety/integrity failure; this is not an employer cutoff.
Record help/tool allowances and reviewer type; prefer a human/peer review without claiming one occurred.
Failed dimensions create bounded repair work; passing topics does not create professional tenure or Staff impact.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: An integrated mock spans two existing engineering blocks, not added hours.

Long uninterrupted mocks explicitly rebalance neighboring daily blocks within 180 minutes/day or carry AI work forward. The final milestone consolidates prior assessment evidence and repairs gaps; it does not schedule all formal practice at the end.
required_evidence: Attempt dates/artifacts, dimension rubrics, actual feedback and remediation/retest plan.

units.title: Small StreamForge ranking depth sample

One personally implemented simple ranker/recommender and an offline comparison using justified ranking metrics.
Serve predictions through a small API and explain reproducibility, monitoring/drift and future deployment limits.
acceptance_criteria: Report actual dataset/split/metric definitions and held-out results without tuning the test set.
Show own code/understanding of the baseline/model/metric and analyze one failure.
No fabricated online conversion/A-B uplift; full third flagship is optional and not an application prerequisite.
permissions_and_fallback_limits: GPU, paid compute and large-model training are not prerequisites for this sample.
required_evidence: Data/model manifest, learner implementation/tests, evaluation, served prediction receipt and limitations.

Role-by-role evidence map including experience, location/work authorization/travel and customer-production gaps.

Current AWS syllabus/practical readiness review; SAA exam only if useful, independently ready and separately authorized. AIP remains a later experience/readiness target, not automatic core completion completion.

Mark local, hosted-provider, live-cloud, real-user, production and organizational-impact levels separately.
Public posting, applications, outreach and exam spending occur only with the applicable user instruction/approval.
If required capability gates remain blocked, publish an honest partial-readiness/gap report, not universal FDE-ready status.
